answer:
The order is complete. The final page, https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-complete.html, says "Thank you for your order!" and is still open in its tab.

I logged in as standard_user and sorted by price from low to high. I added the Sauce Labs Backpack ($29.99) and the Sauce Labs Bike Light ($9.99) to the cart. I checked out as Ada Lovelace, postal code 10001.

The order overview showed an item total of $39.98, tax of $3.20 and a total of **$43.18**.

I used only the agent-browser CLI.

tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); echo $S; agent-browser --session $S open https://www.saucedemo.com; agent-browser --session $S snapshot -i
B="agent-browser --session task-4088eb025d31"; $B fill @e5 standard_user; $B fill @e6 secret_sauce; $B click @e4; $B wait --url "**/inventory.html"; $B snapshot -i
